questions.question: Which sentence tells us what is happening right now?
questions.options: Amina helped her mother yesterday. | Amina is helping her mother. | Amina will help her mother tomorrow. | Amina helps her mother every day.
questions.explanation: The present continuous, with 'is helping', tells us about an action happening at this very moment.
questions.sourceUnitTitle: All About Me and My Family

questions.question: Which word means a place where you can borrow and read books?
questions.explanation: A library is full of books you can borrow, read and bring back for others to enjoy.

questions.question: What does 'prepare' mean?
questions.options: To throw something away | To forget about something | To break something into pieces | To get something ready before you need it
questions.correctAnswer: To get something ready before you need it
questions.explanation: When you prepare, you get ready — like preparing your school bag the night before a lesson.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'Last August, we ___ on vacation to the coast.'
questions.explanation: 'Went' is the past of 'go'. It is an irregular verb, so it changes instead of adding -ed.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'July is ___ than January in our town.'
questions.explanation: We use a comparative like 'hotter' to compare two things — here, two months.

questions.question: Which word means a chart that shows the days, weeks and months of the year?
questions.explanation: A calendar shows every day and month of the year, so we can plan birthdays and vacations.

questions.question: Which word means a small town in the countryside where not many people live?
questions.explanation: A village is a small place in the countryside, much smaller than a city.

questions.question: Read this: 'Omar walks to the market with his grandfather. They buy fruit and talk to the shopkeeper. Then they rest in the garden.' Where do Omar and his grandfather rest?
questions.options: At the market | In the garden | At the hospital | At school
questions.explanation: The last sentence tells us: 'Then they rest in the garden.'

questions.question: Choose the best joining word: 'The children were tired ___ they had worked hard all morning.'
questions.explanation: 'Because' points back to the reason — working hard is why the children were tired.

questions.question: Which word means to finish something so that nothing is missing?
questions.explanation: When you complete something, you finish every part of it — like completing your homework.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.options: My brother is more taller than me. | My brother is tallest than me. | My brother is taller than me. | My brother is most tall than me.
questions.correctAnswer: My brother is taller than me.
questions.explanation: To compare two people we say 'taller than' — one comparative word does the whole job.

questions.question: A person who is honest ___.
questions.options: always tells the truth | runs very fast | is never on time | likes loud music
questions.explanation: Honest people tell the truth, even when it is hard. That is why we trust them.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'I have ___ a real mountain forest.'
questions.explanation: After 'have' we use the past participle. 'Seen' is the special past participle of 'see'.

questions.question: Which word tells us how hot or cold something is?
questions.explanation: Temperature measures heat and cold — a hot day has a high temperature.

questions.question: Which word means taking one number away from another?
questions.explanation: Subtraction takes one number away from another, like 10 take away 3.

questions.question: Read this: 'Layla measured the table. It was one meter long. Her pencil was much shorter.' Which sentence is true?
questions.options: The pencil is longer than the table. | The table and the pencil are the same size. | Layla measured the chair. | The table is longer than the pencil.
questions.correctAnswer: The table is longer than the pencil.
questions.explanation: The pencil is much shorter, so the table must be longer than the pencil.

questions.question: Which word is an abstract noun — something you cannot see or touch?
questions.explanation: Kindness is a feeling and a quality. You cannot hold it in your hand, but you can always share it.

questions.question: Clap the beats: how many syllables does the word 'imagine' have?
questions.explanation: I-ma-gine — three claps, three syllables.

questions.question: Today is Monday. What day comes next?
questions.explanation: The days go in order: Monday, then Tuesday.

questions.question: Who helps sick people in a hospital?
questions.options: a nurse | a firefighter | a bus driver | a shopkeeper
questions.explanation: A nurse cares for sick people in a hospital and helps them get better.

questions.question: Which word means to jump on one foot?
questions.explanation: When you hop, you jump up and down on one foot — like a happy frog!

questions.question: What do we call the time when the sun comes up in the morning?
questions.explanation: Sunrise is when the sun rises and the day begins. Sunset is when it goes down.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.options: The tower is high than the house. | The tower is higher than the house. | The tower is more high than the house. | The tower is highest than the house.
questions.correctAnswer: The tower is higher than the house.
questions.explanation: When we compare two things, we add -er: 'higher than the house'.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'bug'?
questions.explanation: Bug and rug both end with the -ug sound, so they rhyme.

questions.question: Read this: 'Sara takes the bus to the city. She visits the park and eats lunch near the fountain.' How does Sara go to the city?
questions.options: By bike | By bus | On a train | In a boat
questions.explanation: The first sentence tells us: 'Sara takes the bus to the city.'

questions.question: Which word begins with the same sound as 'sun'?
questions.explanation: Sun and six both start with the sss sound of the letter s.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.options: I can reads a book. | I cans read a book. | I can reading a book. | I can read a book.
questions.explanation: After 'can' we use the plain verb: I can read.

questions.question: Who is your mother's mother?
questions.options: your grandma | your sister | your teacher | your baby brother
questions.explanation: Your mother's mother is your grandma — one of your grown-ups who loves you.

questions.question: Read this: 'The duck and the frog sit by the water. The rabbit hops on the grass.' Who hops on the grass?
questions.options: The duck | The rabbit | The frog | The cat
questions.explanation: The story says: 'The rabbit hops on the grass.'

questions.question: In which room of the house do we cook our food?
questions.options: the bedroom | the bathroom | the kitchen | the living room
questions.explanation: We cook in the kitchen — that is where the sink, the pots and the yummy smells live.
